_comment: 由 sync_translation.py 维护，请勿手改。记录上次确认时每个已翻译键的英文原文。

line:menu_translation/notification-tweak.$NT_CompatHint: Some mods split one long message into two notifications. These rules put the halves back into one line.
line:menu_translation/notification-tweak.$NT_DragTip: Move and resize the notification lines and the big messages in the middle of the screen.
line:menu_translation/notification-tweak.$NT_DrawIconFonts: Draw icon fonts (e.g. Oblivion Interaction Icons)
line:menu_translation/notification-tweak.$NT_DrawIconFontsTip: Some mods put icons from their own font into messages, like the OII save icon. On: the plugin reads that font and draws the icons with the lines. Off: icons are left out; a message that is only an icon goes to the Vanilla HUD.
line:menu_translation/notification-tweak.$NT_EnabledTip: Off: the Vanilla HUD shows notifications again.
line:menu_translation/notification-tweak.$NT_FontMissingGlyphs: Some notifications use letters that no loaded font has. Choose their alphabet in the Menu Framework under Options > Open Settings > Character Glyphs.
line:menu_translation/notification-tweak.$NT_FontSizeTip: Size at 1080p; other resolutions scale with the screen height.
line:menu_translation/notification-tweak.$NT_Footer: Changes apply immediately and are saved.
line:menu_translation/notification-tweak.$NT_HistoryHide: Hide this message in the HUD. It stays in the history; numbers match any number.
line:menu_translation/notification-tweak.$NT_HistoryHideOff: Hiding works while "Replace Vanilla notifications" is on.
line:menu_translation/notification-tweak.$NT_HistoryHint: The last 100 notifications of this session, newest first.
line:menu_translation/notification-tweak.$NT_HistoryTime: Display time for this message (numbers match any number). Right-click: back to the general setting.
line:menu_translation/notification-tweak.$NT_HistoryTimeOff: Own display times work while "Replace Vanilla notifications" is on.
line:menu_translation/notification-tweak.$NT_HistoryUnhide: Hidden in the HUD. Click to show it again.
line:menu_translation/notification-tweak.$NT_ImmediateTip: Off: one new line per delay step, like the Vanilla queue.
line:menu_translation/notification-tweak.$NT_MergeBosTip: Pink thought lines (CustomComments.esp) whose first part does not end a sentence.
line:menu_translation/notification-tweak.$NT_MergeGenericTip: First line without a sentence end, second line starts lowercase. Can also join unrelated messages.
line:menu_translation/notification-tweak.$NT_MergeYpsTip: Recognizes the exact split position YPS uses for thoughts longer than its limit (80 characters by default).
line:menu_translation/notification-tweak.$NT_PosWindowHint: Drag a frame to move it, arrow keys for fine steps (Shift: larger), mouse wheel resizes it, right-click puts it back.
line:menu_translation/notification-tweak.$NT_Sample2: Drag with the left mouse button
line:menu_translation/notification-tweak.$NT_ShowInMenusTip: Off: while the inventory, map or another full-screen menu is open, notifications wait and appear when it closes.
